title: Weighted Hardy Inequalities for Nested Averages
summary: We study a family of Hardy-type inequalities for weighted averages over nested subsets of a measure space. Given a partition of a measure space and a weight function $m$, we consider operators of the form \[ f \mapsto \frac{1}{M_n}\int_{X^{(n)}} m(x)f(x)\,\mathrm{d}μ(x), \] with additional weights on the resulting sequence of averages. In particular, we generalize an inequality obtained by Vincent and Sohani in \cite{VincentSohani2025} and characterize the boundedness in terms of the finiteness of a single testing quantity $β$.
